task.title: Installation
task.shortdesc: How to install on your system.

prereq.p: Before installing , make sure you have:

ul.li: Operating system: Windows 10+, macOS 12+, or a supported Linux distribution.
Disk space: At least 500 MB of free disk space.
Memory: At least 4 GB of RAM.

step.cmd: Download the installer from the official website.
Run the installer and follow the on-screen instructions.
Accept the license agreement and choose the installation directory.
Click Install to begin the installation.
When the installation completes, click Finish.

result.p: is now installed on your system. You can launch it from the Start menu (Windows), Applications folder (macOS), or your desktop shortcut.
